reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is a visual slide-deck editor inside DeepSeek Harness conversations, with an AI-annotation workflow for deck modifications and Workspace-backed document management. Evidence shows it is purpose-built for creating, loading, editing, and exporting presentation content rather than general code-generation or system tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中使用的可视化幻灯片编辑插件，可将当前对话切换为幻灯片编辑模式，并通过 AI 标注子代理在工作区文档上进行多页幻灯片的编辑、保存与导出。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness conversation plugin that provides a visual slide editor mode with AI annotation subagents, enabling multi-slide deck editing, workspace-backed loading/saving, and presentation-style export from the active session.

capabilities: Load, create, save, and close slide deck documents stored in Workspace file paths.
Run conversation-scoped AI annotation subagents that can apply deck/page/element update operations.
Provide a slide-editor UI in the conversation context with canvas selection, thumbnails, and presentation export.

reasons.code: The plugin is described as a per-Conversation visual slide editor that replaces the chat surface for a selected conversation and operates on slide decks.
It defines an open_slide_deck tool that opens Workspace-relative slide documents and enforces session-specific invocation constraints.
Workspace file picker flows for New/Load/Save/Save As and per-session document path association indicate direct file persistence and mutation in the host workspace.
